description: Keeps Bluetooth speakers and headphones awake by continuously playing a near-silent sound. Press NVDA+Windows+B to toggle, NVDA+Shift+Alt+B to change the sound (quiet low tone, quiet high tone or true silence) and NVDA+Control+Shift+B to change the tone volume.
changelog: Changed the default toggle gesture from NVDA+Shift+B to NVDA+Windows+B to avoid a conflict with NVDA's Report battery status command.
